text: The owner of 8 Faraday Drive has applied to Scarborough Community Council for a site-specific exemption from the requirements of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447, Section 447-1.3C (3) and section 447-1.3E (1)(b). The property owner is seeking Council’s permission to install a Juliette-style gate in the rear yard to provide access from the walkout basement to the enclosed pool area. The proposed gate will be constructed of clear tempered glass and will measure approximately 1.2 metres in height and 0.81 metres in width, with self-closing and self-latching mechanisms. The proposed gate does not comply with the access protection and construction requirements of Chapter 447 of the Toronto Municipal Code. Refused to grant the requested exemption to Chapter 447, Fences, to the property owner of 8 Faraday Drive, for the proposed fence described in the Summary of the report (May 27, 2026) from the Acting District Manager, Municipal Licensing and Standards, East District.
